query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever earlier, and he rolled in a patch of dandelions on the way home so I had to give him a full bath as soon as we walked in the door. Then I remembered I needed to restock my favorite matcha latte mix, but the grocery store near my place was all out of the unsweetened version I like, so I had to order it for delivery tomorrow. Oh, and my houseplant that I’ve been trying to keep alive for three months finally grew a new leaf this morning, I was so excited I took like ten photos of it to send to my mom. Anyway, I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W3388163, I want to swap item 9354168549 for item 2060066974, and use paypal_5334408 as the payment method for any extra costs that come up with the exchange.
